findings_shown: Employment level in Information & Communications rose by 14.4% between 2020 and 2024.
Employment level in Information & Communications grew at a compound rate of 3.4% a year between 2020 and 2024.
Employment level in Information & Communications fell by 3.1% between 2022 and 2023.
Employment change in Information & Communications summed to +26,800 persons over 2020-Q1 to 2024-Q4.
Employment change in Information & Communications averaged 2,600 persons less in 2022-Q3 to 2024-Q4 than in 2020-Q1 to 2022-Q2.
Job vacancies in Information & Communications rose by 21.7% between 2020-Q1 and 2024-Q4.
Job vacancies in IT & Other Information Services rose by 27.5% between 2020-Q1 and 2024-Q4.

Job vacancies in Information & Communications and employment change in Information & Communications in the same quarter tended to be higher together between 2020-Q1 and 2024-Q4 (Pearson r 0.47 over 20 quarters; exploratory, not evidence of cause).
